newsitem.title: USA: Harnischfeger Industries Q1 net up as margins rise.
newsitem.headline: Harnischfeger Industries Q1 net up as margins rise.

text.p: Harnischfeger Industries Inc said Wednesday a sharp increase in operating margins helped earnings in the first quarter reach record levels.
Net income in the period ended January 31 was $30.9 million, or $0.65 a share, compared to $23.2 million, or $0.50 a share, in the first quarter one year ago, the company said.
Harnischfeger said sales rose to $699.4 million from $632.7 million in the first quarter in 1996.
Harnischfeger Industries owns companies that make and distribute equipment used in mining and paper manufacturing.
Its shares were trading down 3/4 Wednesday at 44.
